ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels, with high-intensity areas concentrated on the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region covering roughly 70% of the surface area. High-intensity mottling and solid banding originate at the mid-lobe point and extend to the distal tips. Contiguous dark circular spots (5-15 pixels in diameter) are embedded within the white high-intensity fields at both fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and continuous serration across the entire trailing edge boundary. High-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) occur at an interval of approximately 20-30 pixels along the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the leading edges with a sharp recurve towards the trailing edge, forming tapered, pointed distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured clusters (light-colored with dark centers) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual circular white points (3-8 pixels in diameter) are detected across the dark central field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear disruptions. One prominent vertical mark on the left lobe (roughly 1/3 distance from the notch) and several thinner horizontal linear marks on the right lobe breaking the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips. Distinct white linear rake-like marks on the left lobe. Small circular pockmarks scattered across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of textured bio-fouling/barnacle growth at the fluke tips creates a unique, highly irregular silhouette compared to the smoother main edge.
